name: Page Industries Ltd.
business_summary: Exclusive licensee of Jockey International for innerwear, loungewear and athleisure in India, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Nepal, UAE, Oman, Qatar and expanding to Saudi/Bahrain/Kuwait; also Speedo licence. FY26 sales Rs5,247 cr, EBITDA Rs1,153 cr (22%), PAT Rs764 cr, ROE ~54%, payout ~80-138%. Q1 FY27 sales Rs1,420 cr (+8%), OPM 20%, PAT Rs193 cr (-4%). Promoters 42.89%, FIIs 18.8%, DIIs 32.9%. Stock Rs35,742, P/E 51; shares -10.9% 12m, -10.7% 3m.

revenue_mix.geography: India with small export/ Middle East licensed territories

exposures.mechanism: Raw materials ~45% of sales (model estimate; gross margin ~55%); cotton yarn/knit fabric ~50% of material cost; +10% cotton => yarn +~6% => cost +1.35% of sales => EBITDA -6.4% on 21% margin; Page passes through ~50% via price hikes within 2-3 quarters => -3.2%; EV/MCap 1.0 x persistence 0.3 = -1.0, rounded -1.2. Pack empirical -1.37 (t -1.7): agrees. Cotton is +19.7% 12m, +1.9% since June: margin headwind largely already visible (OPM 20% in Q1 vs 22-23% prior year).

evidence.note: screener.in standalone fundamentals through Jun-2026, shareholding to Sep-2026, upcoming result date 12 Nov 2026 (fetched directly; pack had no dossier)

exposures.mechanism: Innerwear/ athleisure is discretionary-lite but premium-skewed (Jockey); +5pp urban consumption growth => +3% volumes (elasticity ~0.6) => revenue +3% (~Rs160 cr) at ~35% drop-through (fixed manufacturing cost) = Rs56 cr = +4.9% EBITDA (Rs1,147 cr TTM); x1.0 x persistence 0.7 = +3.4. FY27 volume growth target 11% (NiftyTrader preview) vs Q1 revenue +8%.
